listen_host.description: Network interface IP address on which the GRAM Job Manager listens for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: TCP port number on which the GRAM Job Manager listens for incoming connections.

auth_method.description: Authentication method: 'gridftp' (GSI proxy), 'gsi' (GSI credentials only), or 'none' (no authentication).

proxy_cert_path.description: Path to the host certificate used for GSI proxy authentication.

proxy_key_path.description: Path to the host private key used for GSI proxy authentication.

ca_cert_dir.description: Path to the directory containing trusted CA certificates for GSI authentication.

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr or log file.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to empty string to disable file logging.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrently active jobs the manager will handle. Increase for high-throughput sites.

max_queue_depth.description: Maximum number of jobs waiting in the submission queue. Set to 0 for unlimited.

gridftp_endpoints.description: List of GridFTP endpoints used for data staging during job execution.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the GridFTP server.

description.description: Human-readable description of the GridFTP endpoint.

proxy_mode.description: GSI proxy delegation mode for this GridFTP server (optional).

jobmanager_types.description: List of jobmanager types supported by this service (e.g., 'jobmanager', 'jobmanager+pbs'). Must match available jobmanager implementations on the system.

job_wrapper_path.description: Path to an optional job execution wrapper script that runs before user jobs.

resource_manager_plugin.description: Resource manager plugin to use (empty to use default auto-detection or legacy behavior).

resource_manager_config_path.description: Path to the resource manager plugin configuration file.

gsh_enabled.description: Enable Grid Shell (GSH) support for job execution environments.

gsh_shell.description: Default shell for GSH execution environments.

gsh_working_dir.description: Working directory for GSH execution environments.

service_hostname.description: Public hostname used in the service contact URL (e.g., for discovery by clients).

service_port.description: HTTPS port used by the service contact URL.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS for the service contact endpoint.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate used for the service contact endpoint.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key used for the service contact endpoint.
